title: mold_v0 application spec
description: A complete description of one mold_v0 application, as one file. Check it with python3 .claude/scripts/factory.py spec check <file>; mint it with python3 .claude/scripts/mint.py new <app_id> --spec <file>. Generated by .claude/scripts/app_spec.py generate: never edit by hand.
markdownDescription:
A complete description of one **mold_v0** application (an MCP product: workspaces, keys, an MCP connector, an admin console, and the packs' records and runs).

- Check: `python3 .claude/scripts/factory.py spec check <file>`
- Mint: `python3 .claude/scripts/mint.py new <app_id> --spec <file>`

_Generated by `.claude/scripts/app_spec.py generate`; never edit by hand._

kind.description: tool (default): people open the app itself. embedded: the app runs inside another product, which needs a developer surface and the platform audit trail.
kind.markdownDescription:
- `tool` (default): people open the app itself.
- `embedded`: the app runs **inside another product**; it then needs `developer_surface` and `audit.platform: true`.

product.description: The brand: name, colour and logo are required (an app never ships under the mold's default name), tagline and domain optional.
product.markdownDescription: The brand people see. **name, colour and logo are required**: every new app is branded before its first deploy, never shipped under the mold's default name. `branding.py` derives the rest (palette, icon, sign-in mark) from these three.

deploy.title: Where it runs
deploy.description: Where the app runs: compose_remote, vercel (molds/mold_v0/mold.json targets).
deploy.markdownDescription:
Where the app runs (`molds/mold_v0/mold.json` `targets`):

- `vercel`: two Vercel projects, the API and the web console.
- `compose_remote`: a server of its own (Docker Compose behind its own Caddy); needs `product.domain`.

workspace.description: Who runs the app. mold_v0 needs at least one platform administrator; its companies are made in its own admin console.
workspace.markdownDescription:

`name`, `owner`, `members` are not supported on mold_v0: mold_v0 has organisations of its own, made in its admin console or by its org:create script, not workspaces written from state.

budgets.title: Spending and rate limits
budgets.description: The app's limits over the shell's defaults (written to profile.limits): runs.budget_usd_max is the most one run may spend (US$), runs.kind_month_budget_usd the most one job kind may spend per company per month. Each is capped by the factory's ceiling.
budgets.markdownDescription:
The app's limits over the shell's defaults, written to `profile.limits` (a brief's `## Budgets`).

- `runs.budget_usd_max`: the most **one run** may spend, US$ (shell default 25).
- `runs.kind_month_budget_usd`: the most **one job kind per company per month**, US$ (default 200).

Each is capped by the factory's ceiling (`molds/mold_v0/branding/rules.json` `app_limits_max`). **Required when a pack has job kinds**, and must cover each kind's own `budget_usd` / `month_budget_usd`.

onprem_runners.markdownDescription:
**On-premises runners**, off unless `true` (mold_v0-205, the shell's `src/onprem-runners.ts`).

- `true`: a workspace's owners add a runner on **Credentials** and install it inside their network; the runs of a kind with `private_network: true` then go to it when the workspace chooses so.
- `false` or absent: `/api/runners` and `/api/runner` answer not found, no console page, admin tab or guide page for runners appears, enrolment is refused and every run is hosted.

Brief line: `onprem_runners = true` in `## Profile`.

run_keys.title: Keys the runs need (names, never values)
run_keys.description: Where the keys the pack's job runs need will come from. Names only: the values go into the app's Key vault (its /admin Key vault page) or the server's environment, never here.
run_keys.markdownDescription:
Where the keys the packs' **job runs** need come from. **Never a value here**: the operator puts each key in the app's **Key vault** (`/admin` → Key vault), or in the server's environment.

- `model`: `anthropic` (an Anthropic API key) or `vertex` (a Vertex AI service-account key: Claude then runs on Vertex AI).
- `sandbox`: `boat` (boat.dev runs the sandboxes on Vercel).
- `object_storage`: where workspace snapshots go: `vault` (the Key vault's Object storage), `r2_env` (R2_* on the server) or `storage_dir` (APP_STORAGE_DIR, a server of its own).

Whether each is set: `provision.py <app> --operator vault-status --dry-run`.

audit.title: Audit trails (mold_v0-197)
audit.description: Two audit trails, each on or off on its own (both default false). Separate from usage metering, which always stays on. mold_v0 writes it to the app's profile.audit (mold_v0-197, src/audit-trail.ts; entries kept 400 days unless profile.audit.retention_days says otherwise).
audit.markdownDescription:
Two audit trails, **each on or off on its own** (both default `false`).

- `data`: every read, change, reveal and export of a workspace's records, visible to that workspace's admins.
- `platform`: every API and MCP request and every sign-in, with the key, the actor and the scope, plus staff actions on accounts.

Separate from **usage metering**, which always stays on. An `embedded` app needs `platform: true`.

_mold_v0 writes it to the app's `profile.audit` (mold_v0-197, `src/audit-trail.ts`); entries are kept 400 days unless `profile.audit.retention_days` says otherwise._

data.title: Data audit trail
data.description: Every read, change, reveal and export of a workspace's records, visible to that workspace's admins.
data.markdownDescription: **Data audit trail**: every read, change, reveal and export of a workspace's records, shown to that workspace's admins. Default `false`.

platform.title: Platform audit trail
platform.description: Every API/MCP request and sign-in, with key, actor and scope, plus staff actions on accounts. Required (true) for kind embedded.
platform.markdownDescription: **Platform audit trail**: every API and MCP request and every sign-in, with the key, the actor and the scope, plus platform staff's actions on accounts. Default `false`; **must be `true` when `kind` is `embedded`**.

sign.title: Chain and sign
sign.description: Signed checkpoints of the hash-chained trails (mold_v0-195): hourly Ed25519 signatures over Merkle roots, verifiable offline with the app's public key. Needs APP_LEDGER_SIGNING_KEY in the app's environment.
sign.markdownDescription: **Chain and sign** (mold_v0-195): every trail entry is hash-chained in the database; with `sign: true` a scheduled job also signs checkpoints (an Ed25519 signature over the Merkle root of each window of entries, hourly when there are new ones), verifiable by the workspace's owners and offline with the public key at `/.well-known/ledger-keys.json`. Default `false`. The key, `APP_LEDGER_SIGNING_KEY`, is set in the app's environment by name (never in the database). mold_v1: recorded with the spec only.

developer_surface.title: Developer surface (mold_v0-193)
developer_surface.description: What a host application's developers build against when this app is embedded in it: the events it emits to webhooks, the SDK languages generated, the client sessions the host's backend mints, and optional inbound webhook receivers. mold_v0 builds it (the REST API at /v1, /openapi.json, keys, client sessions, webhooks out and in, the SDKs): mint new --spec writes it into the app's first inline pack as pack.json developer_surface. mold_v1: recorded with the spec only. Required when kind is embedded.
developer_surface.markdownDescription:
What a **host application's developers** build against when this app is embedded in their product.

- `events`: what the app sends to the host's webhooks (mold_v0: `record.created`, `record.updated`, `record.state_changed`, `record.deleted`, `run.finished`, `clock.overdue`; a record event may name `areas`).
- `sdk_languages`: the SDKs generated (mold_v0: `typescript`, `python`).
- `client_sessions`: short-lived sessions the host's own backend mints for its signed-in users.
- `webhooks_in` (optional): receivers that write a signed payload into a workspace record area.
- `api_version` (optional): the dated version.

**mold_v0** implements it (mold_v0-193): `mint.py new --spec` writes it into the app's first inline pack. Required when `kind` is `embedded`.

pack_ref.title: One pack
pack_ref.description: A pack the app adds to the mold: its id (packs/<id>/ on this machine), {"id", "path"} to a pack.json file, or {"id", "pack"} with the pack.json inline.
pack_ref.markdownDescription:
A pack (the app's own records, jobs, tabs, words: config only, no fork). Three forms:

- `"acme"`: the pack already on this machine, `packs/acme/files/packs/acme/pack.json`.
- `{"id": "acme", "path": "specs/acme.pack.json"}`: a pack.json file.
- `{"id": "acme", "pack": { ... }}`: the pack.json **inline**, checked against the mold's own `packs/pack.schema.json` (embedded here).

features.title: Capability flags (mold_v0-219)
features.description: One on/off flag per optional capability of mold_v0 (codebase/src/features.json). A capability is on when something asks for it (a pack's declaration; the audit toggles always) and its flag is not false. Written to profile.features; brief lines features.<flag> = true|false.
features.markdownDescription:
One **on/off flag per optional capability** (`molds/mold_v0/codebase/src/features.json`). A capability is **on** when something asks for it (a pack's declaration; the audit toggles always) **and** its flag is not `false`. Leave a flag out for its default.

Written to the app's `profile.features`; in a brief, `features.<flag> = true|false` lines in `## Profile`. `factory.py spec check` says the effective flags.

customer_key_vault.title: Workspace credentials (mold_v0-034)
customer_key_vault.description: Each workspace keeps its own credentials for the packs' runs (write-only, sealed with the workspace's key): the console's Credentials page (Settings › Credentials), /api/credentials, its OAuth connections (/api/credential-connections) and GitHub App installation (/api/github-app). Asked for when a pack declares credential fields (pack.json credentials). Default true. Off: No Credentials page or sidebar entry, and /api/credentials, /api/credential-connections and /api/github-app answer not found. Refused while a job kind needs a credential that is not optional (nobody could give it).
customer_key_vault.markdownDescription:
**Workspace credentials** (mold_v0-034; board name `vault`). Each workspace keeps its own credentials for the packs' runs (write-only, sealed with the workspace's key): the console's Credentials page (Settings › Credentials), /api/credentials, its OAuth connections (/api/credential-connections) and GitHub App installation (/api/github-app).

- **Asked for** when a pack declares credential fields (pack.json credentials).
- **Default** `true`.
- **Off**: No Credentials page or sidebar entry, and /api/credentials, /api/credential-connections and /api/github-app answer not found. Refused while a job kind needs a credential that is not optional (nobody could give it).

Brief line: `features.customer_key_vault = false` in `## Profile`.

company_email.title: Company email (mold_v0-192)

scheduled_alerts.title: Scheduled alerts (mold_v0-035, mold_v0-191)
scheduled_alerts.description: The daily due-date notices and their emails, and the clocks' reminders and escalation steps (an in-app notice, an email, a reassignment or a raised value): the Notices page and /api/notices. Asked for when a record area declares due dates (record_areas[].due), or a workspace area declares clocks (record_areas[].clocks, with record_clocks on): their reminders and escalation steps. Default true. Off: No due-date notice or email is posted and no clock step runs (clocks still show each record's deadline and status when record_clocks is on); no Notices page or sidebar entry, and /api/notices answers not found.

audit.sign.title: Chain and sign (mold_v0-195)

On, the app needs APP_LEDGER_SIGNING_KEY, which the factory makes (mold.json profile_secrets, lib/ledger_key.py: provision.py <app> --generate-secret APP_LEDGER_SIGNING_KEY; mold_v0-227). Off: No checkpoint is signed, no route or well-known key answers and no tool is listed (the chain itself is always kept where entries are written). Needs one of audit.data, audit.platform on. developer_surface.title: Developer surface (mold_v0-193)
developer_surface.description: The REST API at /v1, /openapi.json, scoped keys, client sessions, Standard Webhooks out and in, the SDKs, the developer console (Settings: API keys, Allowed origins, Webhooks, Integrations) and Health's Webhook Delivery tab. In the app spec `kind` stays the switch: kind embedded (with its developer_surface block) is what requests it; this flag only turns a declared surface off and must agree with kind. Asked for when a pack declares developer_surface (in the app spec: kind embedded with a developer_surface block). Default true. Off: Nothing of it is mounted, no table is read, no event is queued and no page shows. Needs audit.platform on.
